items.behaviorSummary: Removes one failed upgrade slot from an item (the Magnificent variation removes all failed slots at once). It can only be used on items that have been upgraded and currently have at least one failed slot, and the restoration always succeeds.
items.description: A legendary scroll with the unique ability to remove a failed upgrade slot from an item.

rows: 20% chance; quantity 1; 2 loot rolls (chance per roll); Must be alive when the dungeon is won

Ethera weekly reward pool: previously absent → includes Holy Scroll.

abilities.description: Throw a rock at an enemy.
abilities.name: Rock Throw

details: Mushroom Bomb perk throws a mushroom spore projectile with particles/trail and an appear sound on impact.
On landing, it spawns a mushroom that detonates after 1.5s in a green AoE scaled by bonusAbilityRadius.
Mushroom blast deals adaptive AoE damage, then applies adaptive poison damage once per second for 3 seconds at half base damage.
versionHistory.summary: Added Spore Throw, a Mushroom Bomb variant with delayed poison mushroom explosions.

details: Rock Throw now reads the blessedHaloDagger perk and uses a blessed projectile with a halo impact sound.
Blessed Halo rock hits deal double base damage as magical projectile damage.
Successful Blessed Halo rock hits give the caster a 200 shield for 3 seconds.
Blessed Halo ability use can heal injured friendly or neutral targets near the impact and reduce the current Rock Throw cooldown by 5% after a heal.
Added magical AoE damage handling for haloExplosion and moved Rock Throw cleanup to task.delay.
versionHistory.summary: Added Honey Throw, a Blessed Halo Rock Throw variant with magical halo hits, shielding, nearby ally healing, and cooldown reduction.

details: PvP damage: previously full damage → 75%.
versionHistory.summary: Fire Blast (Salamander) now deals 75% of its normal damage to players.

details: Damage multiplier decreased by 0.5 while its radius, mana cost, and projectile-speed changes remain intact.
versionHistory.summary: Magical Spear Throw now deals less damage.

details: Added magicalSpear for spearThrow when final INT is greater than final STR, with blue emissive spear trail visuals.
spearThrow active perk changes throw damage type to adaptive, and magicExplosion was added as a .5x base magical AoE damage source.
Spear throws now hide equipment slot 1, keep the weapon hidden after the throw animation, and restore the slot 1 manifest manually on landing/expiry.
Magical spear no longer uses the regular spear pierce continuation, uses magicAttack, spawns expanding magicExplosion VFX/light/particles, and deals radius
Mushroom bomb impact handling now requires hitPart, gets the caster via ability_utilities.getCastingPlayer, exits without a caster, and uses that caster for
versionHistory.summary: Rock throw now adds an INT-scaling magical spear variant alongside damage, weapon visibility, impact, and mushroom bomb handling changes.

details: Rock Throw hit security changes to one hit per player per source tag.
Impact feedback now uses the shared impactPart effect and positional sound playback.
versionHistory.summary: Rock Throw's hit limits and impact feedback were updated.

monsters.description: A member of the Sun Bandits. The Sun Bandits are some of the only remaining pure-blooded Qumtarians in the entire world. They're completely ignorant to the world outside of the Whispering Dunes, the farthest they've ever gone was The Gauntlet. Their low intelligence makes them more dangerous to not only others, but themselves too.
monsters.name: Bandit

variations.description: Perhaps the most insane member of the Sun Bandits, and the greatest menace in the Whispering Dunes. Most Sun Bandits avoid associating with him since he doesn't recognize any of them as being allies. Azariah spends most of his time in the little cave he dug out for himself.
variations.dropNote: Chances are shown per loot roll. Repeated rolls are labeled on each item; their percentages are not added together. Quantities are per successful roll.

entries: He wasn't unlike a regular Sun Bandit, but he was driven insane by the whispering voices of the night. The only thing that soothed him was the feeling of blood on his skin, or the taste of blood and human flesh. His savage behavior has made many stop seeing him as a human, but as a monster much like Sarakis or the Scarabs.

variations.name: Azariah the Blood-crazed

details: Hobo Pants base drop chance: previously absent → 1 in 1,024.
versionHistory.summary: Hobo Bandit can now drop Hobo Pants.

versions.headline: Lavalands

heroImage.alt: A blue-robed adventurer with a staff and a horned, black-armored giant with glowing red eyes fight swarms of giant mosquitoes and ants in a smoldering red canyon.
heroImage.caption: Lavalands update artwork supplied by the project owner.

includedVersions.summary: Added Minotaur weapons and helmets, reworked Cultist gear drops, new Slag Slime, Rant and Ancient Remains monsters, Candle Cult PvP rules and projectile pass-through.
Added Brazen Horns drops to Minotaurs and the Blazen Bull and made the Blazen Bull Resilient.

versions.summary: Beyond the scorched edge of Desolation's Hand lies Lavalands, a molten level 60 frontier where Fire Ants, Magma Slimes, Rants and Minotaurs stalk the cooling rock, Baby Dragons prowl the flows, and the Candle Cult's Kindlers keep their flames burning while Avanth Flamewalker recruits a new generation of Dragon Slayers. Minotaurs now carry the Minoaxe, the new Minotaur Hammer and Brazen Horns into battle, Cultists drop a reworked set of level 60 Cultist and High Cultist gear, and projectiles now pass harmlessly through anyone you can't damage.
